messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime pod redwood-runtime-xyz on node gpu-7 restarted due to GPU OOM during prefill. Severity P2. Pagered oncall (maria). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/prefill-oom

maria: On it — spinning up triage. Which pods are affected and any customer impact?

ash: Logs from redwood-runtime-xyz:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 14.30 GiB (GPU 0; 24.00 GiB total), free 3.21 GiB
Context: prefill tokens=118451, kv_cache_size=17.8 GiB
Container restarted with exit_code=137
```
Looks like very large prefill + KV cache blew past the threshold. Detected 2 similar requests in the last 5m from same client key.

leo: I enabled routing fallback to model-small-quant for traffic from that API key and reduced batch size for the model group. Also pushed a temporary gateway cap: `max_prefill_tokens=65536` (will hold for 1h).

support-june: Two customers reported failures (acme-corp, betaapps). One hit 504 timeouts. Drafting a customer update now: "We experienced transient generation failures due to large-context requests; we've rerouted traffic and applied mitigations; engineering investigating root cause and will follow up."

maria: Triage plan:
- Evict oversized KV caches on affected pods
- Cordone/drain node gpu-7 and reschedule pods
- Keep fallback routing + prefill cap
- Send customer update (support-june)
Ash: can you dump per-pod KV sizes and run eviction? Leo: please prepare handoff in 30m.

ash: Running eviction script now: `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/ops/evict-kv?threshold=0.7`
Response: `evicted_pods=[redwood-runtime-xyz, redwood-runtime-abc] reclaimed=18.3 GiB`
Restarting redwood-runtime-xyz -> pod recreated on gpu-9.

sre-bot: Node gpu-7 cordoned and drain started. 4 pods rescheduled to gpu-9/gpu-10. No more restarts observed after eviction.

incident-bot: Pod redwood-runtime-xyz restart completed and healthy. Traffic shifted; latency trending back to baseline. Metrics: error_rate spike reduced from 4.2% -> 0.6% after mitigations.

support-june: Customer update sent and acknowledged by both customers :thumbsup:. Including: what happened, immediate mitigations, ETA for permanent fix (24-48h).

leo: Follow-ups (postmortem actions):
- Gate hard cap for prefill tokens at gateway + customizable per-tenant override
- Implement adaptive prefix trimming for long prompts
- Improve KV cache eviction policy (LRU + size-based proactive trimming)
- Add alert for KV cache > 12GiB per GPU pod
I'll open tracking tickets and owner them.

maria: Handoff to leo for overnight watch. If we see recurrence, escalate to SRE lead. Closing live mitigation for now :white_check_mark:

ash: Saved logs and core dumps to artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/2987654321/ for postmortem.

maria: Thanks team, good job on rapid mitigation.
